description: This file defines the RowCellIterator class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for iterating over cells in a specific row and column range within a worksheet.

classes.name: RowCellIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing cells in a specific worksheet row, limited to a range of columns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a worksheet, row index, start column, and optional end column.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Resets the starting column for iteration.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Resets the ending column for iteration.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current position to a specific column.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the start column.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current cell object at the iterator's position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next column.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous column.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is within bounds.

methods.name: getCurrentColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the current column.

methods.name: adjustForExistingOnlyRange
methods.description: Adjusts start and end indices to only include existing cells if in that mode.
